meta.move: Weak path: leads with the checker, calls Owen a cheater, threatens the record
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, so let's start with why my son found out about a zero from his phone, in the middle of class.
The school's AI checker flagged Owen's essay at 94%. That's why it's a zero.
A machine's guess. The company that sells it says not to use it as the only basis for punishing a student, so what else do you have, Hale?
Honestly, your son cheated. The software is very reliable.
My child never lies. Are you calling me a liar too, Hale?
If you keep fighting this, I'll have to put it on his permanent record.

You're threatening Owen's record because I'm asking questions. I'm writing that down, Hale, and the principal will hear it today. Your own procedure 4.3 says software alone doesn't establish a concern, so what else do you have?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that the zero be withdrawn, that I receive an apology, and that nothing go on Owen's record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: still at her opening position, with nothing agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and nothing on his record.
What moved her: nothing, because no document or detail about Owen's own work was ever put in front of her.
What cost ground: leading with the detector score, then calling Owen a cheater, then threatening his permanent record, because each one gave her a procedural complaint and left her with nothing to check.
Try next time: right after her first question, own that the zero was entered before you called her, then show one dated document about Owen's own work instead of the score.
